errors.text_span: 标签文字向右下倾斜显示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis labels are tilted to the bottom right; however, they are displayed horizontally in the figure.

The description does not provide any details about the trend or values of the blue line chart, which represents the 'number of news reports related to COVID-19'. It only mentions its existence and what it represents, but omits any description of its fluctuations, peaks, or troughs, failing to describe half of the chart's data.
